items.name: align
items.signature: fn align<Content, Context>(count: u8, content: &Content) -> Align<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: Aligns its content by indenting the content by `count` spaces.

items.name: best_fit_parenthesize
items.summary: Content that may get parenthesized if it exceeds the configured line width but only if the parenthesized layout doesn't exceed the line width too, in which case it falls back to the flat layout.

items.name: block_indent
items.summary: Inserts a hard line break before and after the content and increases the indentation level for the content by one.

items.name: conditional_group
items.signature: fn conditional_group<Content, Context>(content: &Content, condition: format_element::tag::Condition) -> ConditionalGroup<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: Sets the `condition` for the group. The element will behave as a regular group if `condition` is met, and as *ungrouped* content if the condition is not met.

items.name: dedent
items.signature: fn dedent<Content, Context>(content: &Content) -> Dedent<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: It reduces the indentation for the given content depending on the closest [indent] or [align] parent element. - [align] Undoes the spaces added by [align] - [indent] Reduces the indentation level by one

items.name: dedent_to_root
items.signature: fn dedent_to_root<Content, Context>(content: &Content) -> Dedent<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: It resets the indent document so that the content will be printed at the start of the line.

items.name: empty_line
items.summary: A forced empty line. An empty line inserts enough line breaks in the output for the previous and next element to be separated by an empty line.

items.name: expand_parent
items.summary: IR element that forces the parent group to print in expanded mode.

items.name: fits_expanded
items.signature: fn fits_expanded<Content, Context>(content: &Content) -> FitsExpanded<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: Changes the definition of *fits* for `content`. It measures the width of all lines and allows the content inside of the [`fits_expanded`] to exceed the configured line width. The content coming before and after [`fits_expanded`] must fit i…

items.name: format_once
items.signature: const fn format_once<T, Context>(formatter: T) -> FormatOnce<T, Context> where T: FnOnce(&mut Formatter<'_, Context>) -> FormatResult<()>
items.summary: Creates an inline `Format` object that can only be formatted once.

items.name: format_with
items.signature: const fn format_with<Context, T>(formatter: T) -> FormatWith<Context, T> where T: Fn(&mut Formatter<'_, Context>) -> FormatResult<()>
items.summary: Creates an object implementing `Format` that calls the passed closure to perform the formatting.

items.name: group
items.summary: Creates a logical `Group` around the content that should either consistently be printed on a single line or broken across multiple lines.

items.name: hard_line_break
items.summary: A forced line break that are always printed. A hard line break forces any enclosing `Group` to be printed over multiple lines.

items.name: if_group_breaks
items.signature: fn if_group_breaks<Content, Context>(content: &Content) -> IfGroupBreaks<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: Adds a conditional content that is emitted only if it isn't inside an enclosing `Group` that is printed on a single line. The element allows, for example, to insert a trailing comma after the last array element only if the array doesn't fi…

items.name: if_group_fits_on_line
items.signature: fn if_group_fits_on_line<Content, Context>(flat_content: &Content) -> IfGroupBreaks<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: Adds a conditional content specific for `Group`s that fit on a single line. The content isn't emitted for `Group`s spanning multiple lines.

items.name: indent
items.signature: fn indent<Content, Context>(content: &Content) -> Indent<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: It adds a level of indentation to the given content

items.name: indent_if_group_breaks
items.signature: fn indent_if_group_breaks<Content, Context>(content: &Content, group_id: GroupId) -> IndentIfGroupBreaks<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: Increases the indent level by one if the group with the specified id breaks.

items.name: labelled
items.signature: fn labelled<Content, Context>(label_id: prelude::tag::LabelId, content: &Content) -> FormatLabelled<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: Marks some content with a label.

items.name: line_suffix
items.signature: fn line_suffix<Content, Context>(inner: &Content, reserved_width: u32) -> LineSuffix<'_, Context> where Content: Format<Context>
items.summary: Pushes some content to the end of the current line.

items.name: line_suffix_boundary
items.summary: Inserts a boundary for line suffixes that forces the printer to print all pending line suffixes. Helpful if a line suffix shouldn't pass a certain point.

items.name: soft_block_indent
items.summary: Indents the content by inserting a line break before and after the content and increasing the indentation level for the content by one if the enclosing group doesn't fit on a single line. Doesn't change the formatting if the enclosing grou…

items.name: soft_line_break
items.summary: A line break that only gets printed if the enclosing `Group` doesn't fit on a single line. It's omitted if the enclosing `Group` fits on a single line. A soft line break is identical to a hard line break when not enclosed inside of a `Grou…

items.name: soft_line_break_or_space
items.summary: A line break if the enclosing `Group` doesn't fit on a single line, a space otherwise.

items.name: soft_line_indent_or_space
items.summary: If the enclosing `Group` doesn't fit on a single line, inserts a line break and indent. Otherwise, just inserts a space.

items.name: soft_space_or_block_indent
items.summary: Adds spaces around the content if its enclosing group fits on a line, otherwise indents the content and separates it by line breaks.

items.name: source_position
items.summary: Creates a source map entry from the passed source `position` to the position in the formatted output.

items.name: source_text_slice
items.summary: Emits a text as it is written in the source document. Optimized to avoid allocations.

items.name: space
items.summary: Inserts a single space. Allows to separate different tokens.

items.name: text
items.summary: Creates a text from a dynamic string.

items.name: token
items.summary: Creates a token that gets written as is to the output. A token must be ASCII only and is not allowed to contain any line breaks or tab characters.
